why: "pressed at" on "CD + Digital Media" is right for the CD; with some() it is flagged. Must fail on the rules test.

name: the lacquer rule is vinyl only (Group Therapy's)
why: Shellac 78s and acetates take a lacquer; with the shellac and acetate ids gone they are flagged. Must fail on the rules test.

name: an unknown medium does not block the flag
why: A release with a medium of unknown format might have the fitting one; without the guard the reader keeps the known ids. Must fail on the format-reader test.

name: the sidebar fallback is gone
why: The Digital fixture has no release payload: without the sidebar, no row knows its format and nothing is flagged. Must fail on the digital test.

name: the payload is not read (sidebar only)
why: The vinyl fixture's sidebar says 12" Vinyl too, so its render cannot see this; the format-reader test's jsonTwo (payload "CD + Digital Media", sidebar "Other") gives '' without the payload. Must fail there.

name: the release group's rows get the format too (one-table layout)
why: Without the From column check, the constructed "pressed at" of the release group is flagged as well. Must fail on the one-table test.

name: the format mark is not saved to disk
why: A reloaded Credits render loses data-mb-rel-formats and flags nothing. Must fail on the round-trip test.

name: the saved format mark is not restored
why: Same, from the reading side. Must fail on the round-trip test.

name: the tint setting is ignored
why: sa_findings_tint_format_role off must keep the finding but drop the paint. Must fail on the tint test.

name: the finding runs on every pageType
why: No other render has a Relationship cell marked with formats, so this guard (enabled() names release-credit-tables) is invisible to every spec: the mark exists only where applyRelDetailsToTables() writes it with credits:true. Recorded as pass; a spec would need a non-release render whose Relationship cells carry data-mb-rel-formats.
